items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: They saw that I was a young person, naive, and didn't know whether it was raining, so they taught me how not to let anybody make a bad girl out of me.

ctx.x: All the pickpockets had pimps. But Harry Merrill and Little Harry and them, they were the confidence men. They made their own money by confidencing people out of their own money, you see. But I'll tell you how nice they were. They saw that I was a young person, naive, and didn't know whether it was raining, so they taught me how not to let anybody make a bad girl out of me.
